name: Kenesis — AR Gesture Controlled Robot
shortDescription: Robot driven by hand gestures through Snap Spectacles: Lens Studio → Flask → MQTT → ROS 2 on a Jetson Nano, with a 3-DoF arm.
description:
A modular robot you drive with your hands. Finger gestures tracked by Snap Spectacles move a 2-wheel drive base and a 3-DoF robotic arm, so teleoperation feels like moving your own hands.

Highlights:
- End-to-end gesture-to-motion pipeline: Snap API → Flask server → HiveMQ MQTT → ROS 2 nodes.
- Runs on an NVIDIA Jetson Nano, which handles motor drivers, camera streaming and AI inference on-device.
- A Lens Studio AR app for gesture recognition, with the robot's camera streamed back to the glasses.
- Mobile 2-wheel drive base with modular chassis attachments, including the 3-DoF arm.
- Optimized for sub-100 ms latency; the MQTT layer scales to multi-robot setups.

Repos: [`kenesis`](https://github.com/KushalPraja/kenesis) (team repo) · [`htn_ros2_control_on_jetson_nano`](https://github.com/ANonABento/htn_ros2_control_on_jetson_nano) (ROS 2 motor-controller node on the Jetson).

Submitted as "Kenesis" at Hack the North 2025.
